title: V5 CY: sync-ready attester preflight + catch-up stall + suppression dedup
related_owner_incident: Attester tip_h=33001, proposer ~65k; Sync progress 50% frozen (goal=65300 rem=32299); proposer spam seal_suppressed for same height while attester connected but not synced.
brief: Owner restarted attester with timing off — attester holds half chain and shows Sync progress 50% without advancing; proposer still treats TCP-connected attester as live and spins suppression/gate-wait on one block. Implement: (1) count_live_cluster_attesters → count_sync_ready_attesters using heartbeat chain_tip_height + max_tip_lag + not in active epoch catch-up; (2) fix or improve deep catch-up when lag≫256 (CUP/live_hdr path) so standby attester converges after proposer ran ahead; (3) dedup proposer cluster-gate/suppression logs per target_h across poll ticks and 100s windows — no log carpet for one stuck height.

track_a_sync_ready_preflight.replace_or_split: count_live_cluster_attesters → count_sync_ready_cluster_attesters for seal preflight / cluster_attest_ready / ahead preflight
criteria_per_attester_member: trusted peer: cluster_role=Attester, member instance_id in cluster_cfg.members
heartbeat chain_tip_height Some(h) and proposer_local_tip.saturating_sub(h) <= max_sync_lag_blocks
peer not in active catch-up on proposer sync_live view: !cup_active for that node_id OR lag < SYNC_CUP_TAIL_MAX
track_a_sync_ready_preflight.tests: unit: connected but tip lag 32k → synced=0; tip within 1 → synced=1

track_b_attester_deep_catchup.symptom: Sync progress 50% rem=32299 goal=65300 mem=33001/65300 — no forward progress after proposer restart
investigate: sync_live on_tip: cup_started vs cup_skipped vs live_hdr batch apply
attester drops cluster propose while syncing? untrusted_peer / busy loop
whether attester should prioritize short-tail live_hdr until lag<SYNC_CUP_TAIL_MAX before attesting
track_b_attester_deep_catchup.acceptance: After proposer at H≈65k and attester restart from H=33k: within bounded wall (document in runbook, e.g. T_catchup_1k blocks), attester tip reaches proposer_tip - max_sync_lag; Sync progress reaches 100% or tail_quiet
track_b_attester_deep_catchup.observability: INFO sync_catchup_stall reason=... every 30s when rem unchanged

track_c_suppression_dedup.symptom: Proposer logs endless seal_suppressed / quorum_pending for same height
fixes: Extend ClusterGateDedup (or sibling) to dedup DEBUG pre_timeout attestations_missing per target_h
Do not reset height dedup keys on 100s summary emit for gate WARN lines (or use sticky per-height once per process)
Optional INFO every 10s: cluster_gate_stuck height=H pending_ticks=N (replaces per-poll spam)
When sync_ready_attesters < quorum_k: one WARN cluster_attest_waiting_sync height=H attester_tip=... proposer_tip=... then silence until height changes
track_c_suppression_dedup.tests: simulate gate false for 300 polls → at most 1 WARN per height per 100s window

acceptance_criteria: Proposer with lagging attester: cluster_attest_ready false OR live_synced_attesters=0; no unbounded seal on next_h until attester within max_sync_lag
Proposer logs: no per-poll DEBUG/WARN flood for single stuck height (owner-visible reduction)
CY lab: attester from 33k catches up toward proposer tip — Sync progress rem decreases; sealed heights resume on proposer
Unit tests for sync-ready counter and gate log dedup
cargo test -p pwmd — lib lifecycle + transport as needed
non_goals: Automatic attester state wipe when behind
